name: game-box
description: Game Box — five tiny hyper-casual games in one box. Pure web, no dependencies, ships to iOS via the ios/ shell.

scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js && npm --prefix melt test && npm --prefix skip test && npm --prefix pop test && npm --prefix orbit test && npm --prefix sky-temple test
scripts.screens:all: npm run screens && npm --prefix melt run screens && npm --prefix skip run screens && npm --prefix pop run screens && npm --prefix orbit run screens && npm --prefix sky-temple run screens
